purpose: External independent HI tracer cross-check plus R0-only radius sensitivity on 5 Bound05 Eilers flagged bins

inputs.method_citation: McGaugh 2018 via McClure-Griffiths and Dickey 2007/2016 HI terminal velocity observations

methods.baseline: Compare unchanged model speed with Eilers published radius
methods.additive: Model speed at Eilers published R + 0.155 kpc; not valid full coordinate transform
methods.scaled: Model speed at Eilers published R * (8.277 / 8.122); not valid full coordinate transform
methods.hi: Select nearest Q1 and Q4 published HI row to each of five exact Eilers flagged radii (two tracer regions, not identical 3D spatial positions)
methods.uncertainty: HI uncertainties are not included in downloaded tables. No statistical significance claimed, no independent-point confidence estimates.

limitations: R0 change requires original source sky positions, distance estimates and solar motion to recalculate galactocentric radius and velocity; the two sensitivity transforms are NOT astronomical data reductions.
McGaugh 2018 HI derived curves are normalized at 233.34 km/s and R0 8.122 kpc; do not pretend they are raw HI line-of-sight velocities.
Q1 and Q4 HI tangent-point velocities vary at near-identical radius owing to streaming, spiral structure and methods; their mean is illustrative, not a prescribed physical average.
The five Eilers bins were selected after seeing the discrepancy; this is a targeted cross-check, not five independent pre-registered random samples.
HI tables do not supply uncertainties or covariance; no numerical HI rejection threshold was calculated.
Do not infer changes to gravity laws or a proof of physical toroidal force transmission from these residuals.
No modification to prior Bound 04 or Bound 05 data.
